admission.justification: One test pins that prose markers move with the map while code and escaped brackets do not, so a future remap that touches code spans fails before it lands.

applicability: Own and base Markdown of every aligned card.
conditions: The remap reuses the shared marker grammar, so code spans, fences, multiline spans and escaped brackets keep their bytes.
exclusions: Sides with no renumbering, whose markers are carried over unverified: the identity-map branch continues before any marker read or check, so no verification occurs there.

evidence: Rationale: remap_markers renumbers exactly the markers find_markers reports, reusing its paragraph walk, so code spans, fences, multiline spans and escaped brackets keep their bytes; find_marker_positions exposes the same grammar with in-line positions so callers can judge one exact bracket. No existing grammar function changed. Observed: marker-grammar tests (CRLF, fences, multiline spans, odd/even escapes, width changes).

statement: Rule 4 prose follows: own and base Markdown markers are rewritten with the same number map under the shared marker grammar
